page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head and page number at the top. Below the text: a large title block, "MAXIMILIANI II. IMP. AVG." with "SACRA" beneath it, a subtitle line, and the opening lines of the imperial decree with a large initial M. No margin notes.

main_text.p: 2. Recondamur mox num fuerit Articulis Augustanae Confessionis Imperii Electoribus, Principibus & Statibus Imperii in Comitiis Augustae Anno 1530 oblatae, ut quos ad eam confessionem agnoscunt, sine ulla controversia ad illam referant, & in ipsa Confessione ad quam statu aliquam non traduxerint. [illegible, ~40 letters] tempore [illegible, ~30 letters] Tractatus [?] in eis ob [illegible, ~20 letters] ut recipiat [illegible, ~60 letters].

3. Quia autem ad Imperatoris Catholicos proficiscitur sed tractatum [illegible, ~50 letters] ut Religionis Catholicae [illegible, ~80 letters] Imperii [illegible, ~70 letters] Catholicae Religioni [illegible, ~60 letters] Lutherani [illegible, ~40 letters].

4. Deinde colligantur ceteri quoque Articuli, qui nunc quidem ad eosdem Augustanae Confessionis pertinent, contra Religionem Catholicam versantur in Confessione, quae Confessio Augustana falsa nunc praeter non tamen dicitur, vel pertinentes pariter approbantur.

5. Pollicetur tamen sicut quorundam Saeculorum, sive quaedam opiniones partim quod fanaticae, quarum non nulli quidem ante etiam Augustanam Confessionem, nullum ab eo tempore citra orbem Christianum ita altere, quae hae ipsa Confessioni Augustanae Catholicae Religioni contrariae sunt. Iterum ideo Lutheranorum [illegible, ~30 letters] Concordiae [illegible, ~60 letters] doctrinae [illegible, ~40 letters] causa intermissa [illegible, ~50 letters].
6. Dei Iesum autem ut in ipsa Christi motu Deo nomine [illegible, ~40 letters] Regnorum ac Dominorum [illegible, ~30 letters] Deo, cujus res [illegible, ~20 letters] Carolo [illegible, ~30 letters].
Nunc vero pollicemur haec Comitiam nostro Spiritu Sanctae Georgio Lauremberg [illegible, ~60 letters] Anno Domini MDLXIV Regnorum nostrorum [illegible, ~20 letters].
Ad mandatum Sacrae Caesareae Majestatis proprium [illegible, ~20 letters].
main_text.head: MAXIMILIANI II. IMP. AVG. SACRA
main_text.p: Maximilianus Secundus Dei gratia Romanorum Imperator semper Augustus, [illegible, ~60 letters] Iohannes Anthonius [?] [illegible, ~50 letters].

page.notes: Page is heavily degraded, with the foxing and stains covering most of the lines. Most of the Latin text cannot be read reliably and is marked illegible.
